contents.name: §II.A Classical motion: uniform magnetic field, harmonic quadrupole, and three mode frequencies, Eqs. (2.1)–(2.17)
contents.support: The source sets the ideal quadratic model and mode-frequency conventions; the item defines its SI matrix data explicitly and proves the sum by a local trace calculation.

contents.name: §II.D An invariance theorem for arbitrary quadratic electrostatic terms, magnetic misalignment, and ellipticity, Eqs. (2.70)–(2.79)
contents.support: The source derives the exact squared sum by factoring the frequency determinant and comparing coefficients. The local item supplies an independent trace(A^2) proof under its stated diagonalizable stable-mode hypothesis.

contents.name: §II.D boundary: higher-order spatial terms and magnetic-field inhomogeneity are outside Eq. (2.79)
contents.support: The item explicitly excludes higher spatial multipoles and magnetic-field inhomogeneity, as the source separates these effects from the quadratic invariance theorem.

contents.name: §5.1 Particle Trajectory and Eqs. (5.1)–(5.12)
contents.reason: The assigned result is a mode-frequency identity; trajectories, amplitudes, energy signs, and orbit shapes are not claimed or needed for its proof.

contents.name: §5.2 Particle Oscillation Frequencies and stability criterion, Eqs. (5.13)–(5.21)
contents.support: This treatment independently gives the ideal axial and radial frequencies and the stable-parameter condition; the item assumes, rather than claims to prove, a complete stable linear-mode basis.

contents.name: §5.3.1 Axial Motion and §5.3.2 Radial Motions, including the invariance theorem Eq. (5.27)
contents.support: Vogel states the squared-sum invariant and its ideal-trap context; the item supplies the full conditional trace proof.

contents.name: §5.3.2 periodic radial-orbit ratios and closed-orbit classification, Eqs. (5.22)–(5.26)
contents.reason: Rational orbit closure and epitrochoid classification are separate results; this pair develops the frequency invariant and a deterministic ratio bound only.
